# Regexes of paths TruffleHog skips (one per line; `#` lines are comments).
#
# The prisma test suites assert that connection strings are parsed and that
# their credentials are redacted from diagnostics, so they are full of fake
# connection URLs with inline credentials. TruffleHog reports them as
# unverified Postgres credentials on every commit that touches those files
# (inline `trufflehog:ignore` cannot cover commits already in history).
# Only this directory is excluded; everything else is still scanned.
^packages/prisma/tests/
# Same reason for the deploy tests: they assert that database passwords are
# read back from containers and never reach a command line, so they hold fake
# `postgresql://user:password@127.0.0.1/…` URLs. The package's src/ is scanned.
^packages/deploy/tests/
